My father was Władysław Skłodowski. He was a teacher of mathematics and physics, and it was from him that I first learned to love these subjects — he kept scientific instruments at home and would explain their workings to me when I was still a child. He and my mother both valued education deeply, and that shaped everything about how I was raised.
